Match sample groups from a metadata CSV

mc_labels_from_metadata.Rd

Read sample names and groups from two metadata columns and align the group labels to the peak-table sample order.

mc_labels_from_metadata(path, sample_names, sample_col, label_col, clean_names = FALSE, 
    remove_suffixes = NULL)

Arguments

path

Local metadata CSV filename. The first row must contain column names. Download remote files before calling this function.

sample_names

Sample-column names to match, in the required output order.

sample_col

Exact metadata column name containing sample identifiers.

label_col

Exact metadata column name containing group labels.

clean_names

If TRUE, also remove the suffixes specified in remove_suffixes from both sets of names before matching. Default: FALSE.

remove_suffixes

Optional trailing strings to remove, for example c(" Peak area", ".mzML"). Suffix removal is case-insensitive and is used only when clean_names = TRUE.

Details

Whitespace and surrounding double quotes are normalized before matching. With suffix removal enabled, suffixes are stripped repeatedly, allowing a name ending in both a file extension and an intensity suffix to match a shorter metadata name. The remaining name matching is case-sensitive. Missing samples, duplicate matching keys, and missing or empty group labels raise an error. Extra metadata samples are allowed.

Value

A character vector named by sample_names, aligned to that order regardless of metadata row order.

See also

mc_prepare, mc_labels_from_csv, mc_labels_from_names

Examples

peak_file <- system.file(
  "extdata", "orbi_iimn_gnps_quant.csv",
  package = "MetaboCensoR", mustWork = TRUE
)
imported <- mc_prepare(
  peak_file, type = "mzmine",
  sample_keywords = c(".mzML", "Peak area")
)
metadata_file <- system.file(
  "extdata", "metadata.csv",
  package = "MetaboCensoR", mustWork = TRUE
)
imported$labels <- mc_labels_from_metadata(
  metadata_file, sample_names = imported$sample_cols,
  sample_col = "Sample name", label_col = "Label"
)
table(imported$labels)
#> 
#>  Blank Sample 
#>      6      3
